spec.hypothesis: Downstream task evaluation: ARC-C/HellaSwag/PIQA/WinoGrande on Qwen2.5-7B at 4x compression. Verify PPL improvements translate to downstream accuracy. Compare baseline bf16 vs uniform 4-bit vs constrained MCKP (hires).

experiment_data.notes: All 3 conditions complete (baseline bf16, uniform 4-bit, MCKP hires). MCKP hires consistently outperforms uniform on all 4 downstream tasks. Average: MCKP 0.6857 vs Uniform 0.6597 (+2.60pp). Recovery rate = 72.8% of uniform degradation. ARC-C: MCKP exceeds baseline (0.5137 vs 0.4957). Results align with PPL trend (baseline 9.81 → uniform 15.45 → MCKP 10.91). Allocation from exp_e constrained_allocation, bit distribution {8:4, 4:100, 2:8}.
